rationale: ResourceService is an Angular @Injectable() class. It is registered in ResourceListModule's providers, injected into ResourceListComponent's constructor, and instantiated by the DI injector in its spec through injector.get(ResourceService). The framework-component-decorator rule describes 'Angular @Component ... or similar framework class decorators [that] register the class with the framework's dependency-injection runtime', with the constructor invoked by the framework, so @Injectable falls within that stated intent. fp-novel is also defensible because the rule's title and examples centre on @Component/@Controller.
prior_verdicts_assessment: The single prior fp-classifier-regression verdict naming framework-component-decorator is correct, and its DI-instantiation evidence checks out.
